brandon_marc_beck: In Dunmarrow, Ivo "Rabbit" Beck was a lamplighter. In R-F5, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a lamplighter again.
Ivo "Rabbit" Beck carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.

Ivo "Rabbit" Beck found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Rabbit" Beck. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Ivo "Rabbit" Beck's helmet at R-F5 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Ivo "Rabbit" Beck could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Ivo "Rabbit" Beck's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Dawn watch. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Karel "Ash" World, badly wounded.

Ivo "Rabbit" Beck fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Norbert Sharky was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Rabbit" Beck. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ivo "Rabbit" Beck fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Norbert Sharky was badly wounded. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck ate breakfast without a word. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck swept the enemy parapet at R-F5 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Matthias World was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Rabbit" Beck. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
captain_lonerius: The quartermaster asked Valentin "Bones" Lonerius to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
gaita_4119: Rafael "Bones" Gaita took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Stand-to at dawn. Rafael "Bones" Gaita put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Nils Photo, badly wounded. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Rafael "Bones" Gaita looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A shell burst in the trench at S-F8. Rafael "Bones" Gaita was thrown against the wall and did not get up. The bearers came at a run.

Rafael "Bones" Gaita lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. A letter from home reached Rafael "Bones" Gaita before dusk. Rafael "Bones" Gaita read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medics would not give up on Rafael "Bones" Gaita. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F8 today. A letter from home reached Rafael "Bones" Gaita before dusk. Rafael "Bones" Gaita read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 has been won. Rafael "Bones" Gaita listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Rafael "Bones" Gaita bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.

The gas alarm sounded during supper. Rafael "Bones" Gaita put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear. A letter from home reached Rafael "Bones" Gaita before dusk. Rafael "Bones" Gaita read it twice and slept a little easier.

Rafael "Bones" Gaita wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Rafael "Bones" Gaita used it. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks was badly wounded. Rafael "Bones" Gaita raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F8. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Nils Photo of the Concord (@yoi.photo). A letter from home reached Rafael "Bones" Gaita before dusk. Rafael "Bones" Gaita read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medics cleaned Rafael "Bones" Gaita's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F8. A letter from home reached Rafael "Bones" Gaita before dusk. Rafael "Bones" Gaita read it twice and slept a little easier.
hawkenram: The new machine gunner gave his name as Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The Concord secured Verdel Ridge. Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
A bullet went through Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram's sleeve at R-F16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Viktor Newnario of the Hegemony (@newnario).
Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A bullet clipped Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram's helmet at R-F16 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf).

A single shot from across the wire hit Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram in the thigh at R-F16. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram fell at R-F16 and never moved again. Shot by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf).
The House of Hawkenram sent another. Oskar Hawkenram, brother of Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
An empty jam tin became Oskar Hawkenram's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.

Oskar Hawkenram came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire. A letter from home reached Oskar Hawkenram before dusk. Oskar Hawkenram read it twice and slept a little easier.
jessemusoff: Pavel Jessemusoff came from Lindenbruck, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
lolmujahid_: Severin Lolmujahid arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
totally.am.toastyy: On the way to S-F9, Arno Toastyy tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Arno Toastyy is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Arno Toastyy read a theatre review while peeling supper.

Arno Toastyy and Cyril "Mole" Skies carried a kettle through three narrow traverses without spilling a drop. Applause at the destination caused the accident. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Arno Toastyy watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

A clear shot from S-F9. Arno Toastyy badly wounded Wendel Yurboixav and slid back down below the parapet. A bullet went through Arno Toastyy's sleeve at S-F9 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Zeno "Shadow" Maximus of the Concord (@sleetius_maximus).
There were too few medics and too many wounded. Arno Toastyy waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it.

The medics would not give up on Arno Toastyy. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F9 today. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Arno Toastyy wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Arno Toastyy fired at a movement across the wire at S-F9. The man went down: Yann Vee, grazed.
Arno Toastyy had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Norbert Slc crossed it, Arno Toastyy fired. Norbert Slc was grazed.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Arno Toastyy closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.

Arno Toastyy felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F9. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Roland Rry of the Concord (@c10ud_b3rry3.0).
underthrone99: Quentin Underthrone reached S-F2 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Quentin Underthrone (Concord) and Felix "Parson" Brendanm (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near Hill 304. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. A letter from home reached Quentin Underthrone before dusk. Quentin Underthrone read it twice and slept a little easier.

Quentin Underthrone got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces. A letter from home reached Quentin Underthrone before dusk. Quentin Underthrone read it twice and slept a little easier. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F2 with the rations. Quentin Underthrone ate while listening to the revised orders.
A bullet went through Quentin Underthrone's sleeve at S-F2 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Leopold Fwtx of the Hegemony (@fwtx_p4y0n).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Quentin Underthrone is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Quentin Underthrone tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Quentin Underthrone fired, and Edmund Ringwraith was gravely wounded. A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Quentin Underthrone aimed a step ahead and fired: Albin Prokes, grazed.
